fixtureNotes.anonymization: Names, original dates, identifiers, and original measurements are replaced with stable numeric aliases, relative offsets, and normalized set values.
fixtureNotes.coverageAdjustments: The second-latest workout is co-located onto the current local day by the DEBUG loader for a multi-workout calendar stress case. One skipped high-load set is added to verify skipped sets do not create personal records.
fixtureNotes.exerciseAliases: Exercise aliases preserve the phone store personal-record identity key, including distinct exercise IDs that can share a displayed name.
fixtureNotes.achievementSemantics: Per-workout expected counts use the production identity key, master exercise units, active people, completed non-skipped sets, and one event per person/exercise key per workout.
